tools.name: recent_chats
tools.description: List the user's recent claude.ai chats, newest first, with chat_id, title and updated_at. Use before to page further back.

before.description: Only chats updated before this ISO timestamp.

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Read one past claude.ai chat by its chat_id. Returns its turns in order. If the result has a next_page_token, call again with it.
